note: H247: G106 warranted +0.1300 with `the null barely moved`. The null cannot move on this leak -- it is predicate-conditional and the leak is an (s,o) edge. Measured within one split, the conclusion survives at +0.1326 and the warrant does not.

controls.name: C4_the_null_can_move_at_all
